correctness.rationale: The specified seven-height word p=(0,2,4,6,1,3,5) has no cyclically adjacent consecutive heights and hence no trivial deletion. Applying the explicit cyclic-height rotation and half-turn symmetry yields the same canonical cyclic representative. Independent bounded enumeration against the Colton-style crossing-exchange pair partition examined all 7·(binomial choice of m,w with gap≥2)=70 candidate triples and found no legal crossing exchange. With no count-preserving move leading away, any reduction to five petals must first increase to nine. The fully explicit path uses T+ to (0,7,6,2,4,8,1,3,5), X(4,2,5) to (0,7,5,3,4,8,1,2,6), then two T− deletions to (0,3,1,4,2), a cyclic rotation of the known five-petal trefoil (3,1,4,2,0). The exact verifier sourced from artifacts/verify_trefoil_excess.py was inspected, and its exhaustive local search and displayed detour were independently reconstructed from definitions. Only the given finite word is exhaustively certified, not arbitrary knots.
